name: electrical_flicker_temporal_brightness
purpose: Test whether repeated large whole-frame brightness changes relative to overall visual motion can identify temporal lighting flicker while rejecting ordinary camera-motion changes.

methodology.feature_1: 95th percentile of absolute consecutive-frame median-brightness change
methodology.feature_2: brightness-change p95 divided by mean-absolute-gray-difference p95
methodology.rationale: Require sustained large brightness changes and require brightness change to be a substantial fraction of total image change, reducing sensitivity to camera motion alone.
methodology.promotion_rule: Research evidence only. This rule is not automatically promoted into Detector v4.
